info.title: Negotiator API
info.description: Documentation and examples for the Negotiator REST API. Some endpoints require the client to supply an OAuth2 bearer token along with the HTTP request, for obtaining one please use the 'Authorize' button bellow. In case you do not have an account with the connected OpenID Connect provider please contact us.
